planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.
For supplier costs: use vatType=3 (NOT id=1) with ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex detects the expense account and applies inngående MVA automatically.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': switch to vatType=3 with single debit posting, OR add both debit+credit with vatType=0.
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.headline: Supplier created but voucher scoring failed on 5/6 checks despite successful API response
what_went_wrong: $REF:supplier_Luna_SL alias was not registered after POST /supplier, causing 3 repeated 422 errors on voucher postings until a GET /supplier call re-registered it.
vatType=3 on account 6340 is not in legalVatTypes for that account, yet the agent persisted with it — likely causing incorrect VAT posting structure that failed scoring checks.
Only 1/6 scoring checks passed despite voucher creation succeeding — the voucher structure (amounts, VAT type, account linkage) was likely wrong for the supplier invoice format expected.
Agent wasted 3 failed POST /ledger/voucher attempts and 2 tool inspection calls before resolving the $REF issue with a simple GET /supplier lookup.
what_worked: Supplier Luna SL was created successfully on first attempt with correct org number, address, and bank account.
Final POST /ledger/voucher succeeded after GET /supplier re-registered the $REF alias.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice (if available) or ensure $REF aliases are confirmed after creation — add a GET /supplier immediately after POST to guarantee alias registration before voucher posting.
Use vatType=1 (inngående MVA 25%) which IS in legalVatTypes for account 6340, and post 3 explicit postings: debit 6340 (net 39800), debit 2711 (VAT 9950), credit 2400 (gross -49750 with supplier).

Investigate why 5/6 scoring checks failed — likely the voucher needs to be posted via /supplierInvoice endpoint or the posting amounts/VAT codes need to match the expected supplier invoice format exactly.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account (second call for account 2400) — could have been fetched in parallel with first account lookup
inspect_tripletex_endpoint POST /ledger/voucher — did not resolve the actual issue
search_tripletex_api 'posting schema supplier field' and 'supplierInvoice create register' — both returned no actionable info and delayed resolution
